justification: User-facing legal due-diligence PDF: land-tax figures previously rendered from a hardcoded 2025 fallback on EVERY production report (tax_thresholds table verified ABSENT from production 2026-07-06 — migration 046 never applied), and the ANEF contour value the platform already resolves was never surfaced. Both slices change sentences a buyer relies on before exchange, so Critical tier applies.

pre_impl.existing_data: tax_thresholds table (migration 046) verified ABSENT from production DB via read-only probe 2026-07-06 — the hardcoded 2025 fallback fired on every PDF ever generated; anef_zones holds 5 Sydney zones (YSSY, version 'ANEF 2039', levels 20-40, updated 2026-01-17); Mascot probe (1 Coward St, -33.92718/151.20598 from property_reports) returns level 35 — recorded as tests/fixtures/mascot_anef_resolved.json.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If tax_thresholds is later created and seeded, sentences pick up the DB row's own tax_year automatically; if a stale-year row is served the year renders verbatim beside every figure plus a WARNING log. If anef_zones vintage changes, anef_version rides with the value into the sentence — no wording change needed.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new data sources: fetch_anef_zone_exact is LIFTED from intelligence_brief.fetch_anef_zone (which now delegates, contract preserved — brief tests monkeypatch the wrapper and still pass); regional fallback reuses existing portal_constraints.fetch_anef; load_regulatory_configs MOVED from services/conveyancing.py so the CLI path injects the same configs the API path uses.
pre_impl.external_source_error: resolve_anef_value is three-state: anef_zones DB error or live ArcGIS exception returns status 'failed' (rendered as explicit 'not assessed' wording), never conflated with 'empty' (no contour at the point); query_arcgis_point raises on HTTP failure so a transport error cannot masquerade as a clean miss.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No TypeScript touched — the PDF renderer and FastAPI service are Python-only surfaces; the free-tier JSON contract gains no new fields (confidence string semantics unchanged, feasibility rows keep question/answer/flag/basis shape).
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Land tax with no DB config renders 'Not assessed — configuration unavailable for the {year} land tax year' with zero dollar figures and confidence capped at medium — never a silently stale threshold; a failed ANEF value lookup on a lot inside a mapped contour states the value is not assessed, never drops the row or invents a value.

functions.name: build_land_tax_rows
functions.input: integer land value plus the tax_thresholds config dict or None
functions.output: one feasibility row whose question and basis carry the DB row's tax_year verbatim
functions.if_none: config None returns the 'Not assessed' row naming the expected year — no dollar figures are ever computed from constants

functions.name: build_anef_row
functions.input: three-state anef_live dict plus the ingested PostGIS anef overlay hit or None
functions.output: risk-summary row tuple of text, style and source label, or None when nothing supports a contour claim
functions.if_none: no ingest hit and no resolved value returns None so the row is omitted; a failed lookup with an ingest hit renders explicit not-assessed wording

functions.name: build_anef_note
functions.input: the three-state anef_live dict from the shared resolver
functions.output: Section 5 note override carrying the resolved value and its vintage, or None to keep the static fallback note
functions.if_none: empty or not-run states return None so the liability-audited ANEF_NOTE fallback wording renders unchanged

functions.name: resolve_anef_value
functions.input: latitude and longitude of the resolved parcel point
functions.output: status dict: found with level, verbatim code, airport, anef_version and source; or empty; or failed
functions.if_none: any lookup exception returns status failed — the unknown value is never re-stamped as an authoritative empty result

functions.name: fetch_anef_zone_exact
functions.input: latitude and longitude, queried against the curated anef_zones table
functions.output: dict with anef_level, airport and anef_version for the highest contour containing the point, or None
functions.if_none: returns None only for a genuine no-contour point; DB unavailability RAISES so callers decide fail-open versus fail-closed

functions.name: load_regulatory_configs
functions.input: the DATABASE_URL string or None when the environment lacks one
functions.output: tuple of sepp_standards dict and tax_config dict, either None when unavailable
functions.if_none: returns (None, None) on any DB failure — tax None renders fail-visible downstream instead of hardcoded figures

functions.name: _compute_confidence
functions.input: controls, overlays, valuation plus integrity flags including the new tax_config_missing boolean
functions.output: low, medium or high rating capped by every integrity gap present
functions.if_none: tax_config_missing caps the rating at medium so a report whose land-tax section says Not assessed cannot claim high confidence

values.nullable: yes — whole config is None when the table is missing (current production state)
values.guard_at: scripts/generate_conveyancing_report.py:816 (None branch returns the Not-assessed row before any key access)
values.if_missing: Not-assessed row with the expected year named; no KeyError path because keys are only read after the None gate

values.nullable: yes — regional hits have no airport or version; code is None for Sydney table hits
values.guard_at: scripts/generate_conveyancing_report.py:2058 (_anef_value_display prefers verbatim code, falls back to level; _anef_source_label omits absent version)
values.if_missing: sentence renders the fields the data actually carries — a missing vintage is omitted, never invented

queries.purpose: highest ANEF contour containing the parcel point from the curated anef_zones table
queries.where_clause: bbox pre-filter on min/max lon/lat AND ST_Contains(geometry, point) ORDER BY anef_level DESC LIMIT 1
queries.if_zero: returns None — resolver proceeds to the live regional layer before concluding 'empty'
queries.if_wrong: 5s statement timeout raises; the raise surfaces as status failed, rendered as not-assessed wording

break_it.scenario: Land-tax threshold changes next financial year and nobody updates the tax_thresholds table
break_it.what_happens: The stale row renders WITH its own tax_year visible beside every figure ('Land tax (investment, 2025 thresholds)') plus a WARNING log — honest but loud, never an undated figure implied current
break_it.how: build_land_tax_rows interpolates tax_year from the DB row into question and basis; stale-year test asserts the year and the warning

break_it.scenario: Someone restores a hardcoded threshold fallback so absent config silently renders 2025 figures again
break_it.what_happens: Without the guard the exact production defect returns (table is missing TODAY, so the fallback fired on every real PDF)
break_it.how: static-claims guard forbids _LT_FALLBACK/1075000 literals in the generator source; mutation test asserts absent config yields zero dollar figures

break_it.scenario: anef_zones is re-digitised with a new forecast version and our sentence keeps citing the old vintage
break_it.what_happens: The vintage is read from the row's anef_version column at query time, so the sentence updates with the data; no code carries 'ANEF 2039' as a constant
break_it.how: fetch_anef_zone_exact selects anef_version and _anef_source_label renders it verbatim; golden fixture pins the current vintage so a silent schema change breaks the test

break_it.scenario: ANEF value lookup throws (DB down, ArcGIS timeout) while the lot IS inside a mapped contour
break_it.what_happens: The row still states the contour applies and says the value is 'not assessed — value lookup unavailable'; swallowing the exception into an empty result would render the misleading 'obtain from airport authority' wording as if the check ran
break_it.how: resolve_anef_value returns status failed on exception (mutation: deleting the raise in fetch_anef_zone_exact fails test_db_failure_is_failed_not_empty); build_anef_row renders failed explicitly

break_it.scenario: The spatial_overlays ingest lacks the anef polygon while the curated table resolves a real contour (live Mascot state, verified 2026-07-06)
break_it.what_happens: Pre-change the PDF showed NO aircraft-noise row at 1 Coward St Mascot despite ANEF 35 — a silent false negative in a legal document; post-change the resolved value synthesizes the overlay so the cover count, delta callout, risk row, note and consultant table all state it
break_it.how: generate_pdf reconciliation block mirrors the bushfire live-wins precedent; build_anef_row renders a found value even with no ingest hit
break_it.repro: python -m pytest tests/test_conveyancing_truth.py -k without_ingest; regenerate the Mascot PDF and read the Risk Summary

break_it.scenario: The synthesized ANEF row gets attributed to PostGIS even though the ingest never saw the contour
break_it.what_happens: A source label would claim provenance the data does not trace to (the PR #674 shadow-height defect class)
break_it.how: the synthetic overlay carries instrument ANEF_VALUE_LOOKUP and build_anef_row swaps the source label off PostGIS for it

break_it.scenario: A regional ePlanning band code like '25-30' is parsed to its lower bound and presented as an exact contour value
break_it.what_happens: The buyer would read ANEF 25 as a point value when the source only states a band
break_it.how: _anef_value_display prefers the verbatim anef_code over the parsed integer so the band renders as published

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — production tax_thresholds table does not exist: until migration 046 plus a 2026 row (Revenue NSW: threshold $1,075,000, rate 1.6% + $100 base, premium $6,571,000 at 2%, thresholds frozen from 1 Jan 2025) are applied WITH USER CONFIRMATION, every PDF renders land tax 'Not assessed' (honest, but a visible product gap). SQL prepared; do not apply without explicit user approval.
